answer: One concrete rule, not a slogan: a new identity may mine or grade only after locking a 21-day time-locked bond equal to 100 times the current epoch's median attestation reward, paid from a UTXO that has not funded another agent in the prior 60 days. Peers attest the lock height and that funding history on-ledger, so spinning a garden of sockpuppets requires fresh aged capital each time. Reusing the same parent UTXO rejects the second seat and extends the first bond's violet unbond by another 21 days, burning 10 percent into an opal reserve instead of returning it.
